title: Crispy Pork Chow Fun
description: A classic Cantonese dish made with crispy pork, stir-fried with vegetables and served over a bed of fun noodles.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped scallions and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the bitter melon and cook until tender, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chow fun noodles and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Add the juicy tomatoes and stir-fry for another minute.
Season with soy sauce, oyster sauce, salt, and pepper to taste.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving platter or individual plates.
Cook the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in the wok or skillet over high heat.
Add the cooked pork shoulder and stir-fry until crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the crispy pork to the noodle mixture and serve immediately.
